title: Trace Ops Weekly Lab Journal — Jan 10 2027
content:
Purpose and scope:
This is the weekly lab-style run of notes from trace-ops. Focus this week: experiments to reduce per-span ingestion cost, dashboard consolidation to lower query cardinality, and validation of new sampling heuristics for low-latency flows. Informal capture — action items and owners at the bottom.

High-level summary (Jan 10–12):
- Spike finished on adaptive reservoir sampling for high-throughput model endpoints. Early results: 18% fewer ingested spans for the 'chat-gen' route with <1% loss in error signal for our regression tests.
- Dashboard tile consolidation pushed to staging; queries simplified by moving from individual-tenant joins to precomputed aggregates. Query runtime for the top-5 pages dropped ~35% in staging preview.
- Cost telemetry anomaly on Jan 9 (outside this capture) traced to a bad retention policy in the regional pipeline; we've mitigations queued but not yet released.

Standup highlights (daily snippets):
- Mon 2027-01-10:
  - Maya: finished instrumentation changes for adaptive reservoir (feature flag: sample.reservoir.v2). Observed weight drift in tail-end traces; added jitter to slot allocation to avoid lockstep.
  - Evan: dashboard consolidation PR ready; needs additional UX sign-off for the per-route cost breakdown tile.
  - Asha: ran local replay test on trace-backfill; noticed 7% lower throughput when KV-cache spans included — suspect serialization overhead.

- Tue 2027-01-11:
  - Priya: ran comparative eval between legacy uniform sampling and reservoir approach on 72h window. Key result: SLO alert triggering precision maintained for latency regressions; recall for rare error classes dropped from 0.91 -> 0.89 (acceptable for canary).
  - Liam: produced a cost sketch showing projected monthly savings if sampling is enabled on the top 10 hottest routes: ~$18k/mo. Chart in linked PR.
  - Decision: enable reservoir sampling under canary (10% traffic) on 'chat-gen' and 'embed' routes for 2 weeks.

- Wed 2027-01-12:
  - Infra: small rolling restart of the trace-ingestor nodes to pick up protobuf codec fix. No data loss observed.
  - Observability QA: ran end-to-end smoke with live traffic replay (10k requests); dashboard tile hit-rate consistent with staging.
  - Note: still have one regression test failing intermittently for a high-cardinality tag extraction path (ticket OPS-1303).

Metrics snapshot (staging vs baseline):
- Trace volume (indexed spans) on canary routes: baseline 2.3M/day -> staging with reservoir 1.89M/day (18% drop).
- Query p95 latency (top dashboards): baseline 1.2s -> consolidated tiles 0.78s.
- Tokenized cost estimate (rough): $0.72/span -> effective $0.59/span after sampling + consolidation (region eu-west-1).

Experiment notes — adaptive reservoir sampling:
- Implementation: reservoir with per-route stratification by tenant and operation, weight decay based on recent error rate and latency deviation.
- Observed quirks: very noisy tenants with very low volume still risk losing rare error spans. Introduced minimal retention multiplier to keep at least N spans/day for any tenant.
- Monitoring: new dashboard 'sampling-health' added to staging. Panels: effective sample rate by tenant, rare-error recall, ingestion delta vs expected.
- Risk: potential blind spot for newly deployed models until reservoir warms up; mitigation: default onboard policy keeps full sampling for first 6 hours after a model rollout.

Dashboard consolidation approach:
- Problem: per-tenant joins in the dashboards were exploding cardinality and causing long-running queries during ad-hoc investigations.
- Fix: precompute per-route, per-hour aggregates in a cheaper store (hourly-agg) and surface those in dashboard tiles.
- Tradeoffs: loss of sub-minute granularity; added a 'live-scan' fallback for investigative panels that will run limited-time queries with cap.

Cost telemetry anomaly follow-up:
- Root cause: regional retention policy misconfiguration in one of the collector clusters caused double-indexing for ~6 hours on Jan 9.
- Mitigation deployed: retention-sync job and alert on index growth rate.
- Postmortem draft linked in OPS-1298. Need legal/compliance signoff before external customer notification.

Pending tickets and blockers:
- OPS-1303: intermittent failure in high-cardinality tag extractor (owner: Maya). Blocking full rollout of sampling for some routes.
- OPS-1310: UX feedback on per-route cost tile (owner: Evan). Waiting on product reviewer (PM: Jonah) to give final thumbs.
- OPS-1298: postmortem and communication runway (owner: Asha).

Decisions made this week:
- Canary reservoir sampling 10% -> scaled to 25% if metrics hold after 7 days.
- Dashboard consolidation to be enabled by default in staging; production rollout after 2-week observation window.
- Keep full-sampling policy for model rollouts (first 6 hours) to avoid cold-start blind spots.

Action items (owner / due):
- Maya: fix OPS-1303 high-cardinality extractor; add additional integration test for tag edge cases. Due 2027-01-18.
- Evan: incorporate PM feedback and land dashboard consolidation PR. Due 2027-01-14.
- Liam: update cost projection with region breakdown and publish to finance. Due 2027-01-17.
- Priya: extend sampling-health dashboard with alert thresholds and test alerts in staging. Due 2027-01-15.
- Asha: finish postmortem write-up and coordinate legal review for OPS-1298. Due 2027-01-19.

Open questions / follow-ups:
- What's the acceptable recall drop for rare error classes across product teams? Need explicit signoff from product and SRE (action: Jonah + SRE lead).
- Should retention tiering be applied earlier for tenants under X requests/day to reduce index churn? Proposal due next week.
- How aggressive can we be with adaptive reservoir time decay parameters without increasing alert fatigue? Need more simulation runs.

Notes to self / informal bits:
- Replay experiment with KV-cache spans removed showed +7% throughput; need to profile protobuf serialization hotspot (likely in trace-ingestor).
- Nice to have: a small CLI tool for quick backfill previews (input: route + 24h window -> estimate spans saved). Slack thread started.

References and artifacts:
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/telemetry/pull/412 (sampling impl)
